'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Timeline of the 2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
****The [[United States Department of Health and Human Services|U.S. Department of Health and Human Services]] says that the [[United States]] has obtained 36,000 doses of the [[Smallpox vaccine#Jynneos|Jynneos]] [[vaccine]] in order to combat the [[monkeypox]] outbreak. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/06/06/us-has-36000-doses-of-jynneos-monkeypox-vaccine-immediately-available-in-national-stockpile.html (CNBC)]
****[[Washington, D.C.]] reports a case of [[orthopoxvirus]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/3512909-first-possible-monkeypox-case-reported-in-dc/ (''The Hill'')] 
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports 77 new cases of monkeypox, thereby bringing the total number of cases in the country to more than 300. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jun/06/uk-records-77-more-cases-of-monkeypox-taking-total-to-302 (''The Guardian'')]
***[[Kosovo]] reports its first suspected case of monkeypox. [https://euronews.al/en/kosovo/2022/06/04/man-isolated-after-showing-symptoms-similar-to-monkeypox/ (Euronews Albania)]
***[[Singapore]] reports its first case of monkeypox in a man who travelled from [[Australia]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/monkeypox-case-transit-passenger-changi-airport-singapore-australia-moh-2729256 (CNA)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
****[[United States Secretary of Transportation|Transportation Secretary]] [[Pete Buttigieg]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/transportation/2022/06/06/pete-buttigieg-positive-covid/ (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Beijing]]
****[[Beijing|Beijing's]] restaurants reopen following a decrease in new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-reports-162-new-covid-cases-june-4-vs-171-day-earlier-2022-06-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Mariupol cholera outbreak]]
**Petro Andryushchenko, advisor to [[Mayor of Mariupol|Mayor]] [[Vadym Boychenko]], warns that [[Mariupol]] may have suffered a [[History of cholera|cholera outbreak]]. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/world/europe/2022/06/06/mariupol-hit-by-possible-cholera-outbreak-ukraine-claims/ (''The National News'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[9th Summit of the Americas]]
**The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] bans the presidents of [[Miguel Díaz-Canel|Cuba]], [[Nicolás Maduro|Venezuela]], and [[Daniel Ortega|Nicaragua]] from attending this year's [[Summit of the Americas]] in [[Los Angeles]], United States. [[President of Mexico|Mexican President]] [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]] announces that he will personally boycott the meeting in response to the ban, sending [[Secretariat of Foreign Affairs (Mexico)|Foreign Secretary]] [[Marcelo Ebrard]] to represent him at the summit. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-excludes-cuba-venezuela-nicaragua-americas-summit-sources-2022-06-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Canada–Chile relations]]
**[[President of Chile|Chilean President]] [[Gabriel Boric]] visits Ottawa to hold a wide-ranging bilateral meeting with [[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/politics/ensure-economic-development-serves-all-trudeau-says-amid-chile-s-mining-reforms-1.5935189 (CTV News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Aftermath of the 2021 United States Capitol attack]]
**[[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Criminal charges in the 2021 United States Capitol attack]]
***Five members of the [[far-right]] group [[Proud Boys]], including leader [[Enrique Tarrio]], are charged with seditious conspiracy for their involvement in the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|January 6 attack]] at the [[United States Capitol]], becoming the second group to be charged with seditious conspiracy in connection to the attack. [https://www.npr.org/2022/06/06/1103364995/proud-boys-leader-tarrio-four-others-charged-with-seditious-conspiracy (NPR)]
*[[Mass media in Latvia]], [[Latvia–Russia relations]]
**[[Latvia]] bans all [[Russia]]-based [[Mass media in Russia|TV media outlets]] that threaten "the territorial integrity and independence of another country", referring to the [[Russo-Ukrainian War]]. The measure will last until Russia [[Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation|de-occupies Crimea]] and ends [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|its warfare against Ukraine]]. [https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/1712832/latvia-bans-all-russia-based-tv-channels (LRT)]
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**A [[federal judge]] in the U.S. state of [[New York (state)|New York]] orders the seizure of two [[private jet]]s, a [[Boeing 787 Dreamliner]] and a [[Gulfstream G650ER]], owned by sanctioned [[Russian oligarchs|Russian oligarch]] [[Roman Abramovich]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/jun/06/roman-abramovich-private-jets-us-government-seize (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Orlando Jorge Mera]], the Environmental Minister for the [[Dominican Republic]] and son of former [[President of the Dominican Republic|President]] [[Salvador Jorge Blanco]], is shot dead in his office. The perpetrator was identified by a presidential spokesman as Miguel Cruz, a childhood friend of the minister. He was later taken into custody. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/dominican-environment-minister-shot-dead-his-office-2022-06-06/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-61712872 (BBC News)]
*The [[Department of Justice and Constitutional Development|South African Justice Department]] confirms that Rajesh Gupta and Atul Gupta of the influential [[Gupta family]] have been arrested in the [[United Arab Emirates]] for engaging in corrupt practices during the [[Jacob Zuma#President of South Africa (2009–2018)|Zuma presidency]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/6/south-africa-confirms-arrest-of-two-gupta-brothers-in-uae (Al Jazeera)]
*The trial of Aydin Coban, a Dutch man accused of harassing and extorting [[Port Coquitlam]] teenager Amanda Todd online prior to [[Suicide of Amanda Todd|her suicide]] in 2012, begins at the [[Supreme Court of British Columbia|British Columbia Supreme Court]] in [[British Columbia]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/aydin-coban-trial-begins-1.6477680 (CBC)]
  
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Partygate]]
**[[Graham Brady|Sir Graham Brady]], chairman of the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]]'s [[1922 Committee]], announces that he has received the 54 letters necessary to trigger a party confidence vote in [[Boris Johnson]]'s [[Leader of the Conservative Party (UK)|leadership]] of the party. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/jun/06/boris-johnson-face-confidence-vote-scores-tory-mps-call-on-him-to-go (''The Guardian'')]
**Boris Johnson survives the [[2022 vote of confidence in the Conservative Party leadership of Boris Johnson|confidence vote]] by a margin of 211–148 and the party will not conduct a leadership election with 58.8% of Conservative MPs voting in favour of Johnson. [https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/politics-live-boris-johnson-set-to-face-confidence-vote-nkkvrj2ww (''The Times'')]
*[[Mali]]an junta leader [[Assimi Goïta]] declares that Mali will return to civilian rule in March 2024. It was supposed to occur this February until being delayed, prompting sanctions from its neighbors. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220606-mali-junta-sets-two-year-delay-until-civilian-rule (France 24)]
